<subject>Re: message from Langenberg</subject>
<body>
will do! The inventory sheets are still being finalized. Could you send over your list as well?

I thought I’d hold off on sending G’s portrait until after the Advent gathering—is that alright? I CAN send it earlier if you want. Her kindergarten photos just arrived too.

Sorry I missed your call last night. We were picking out decorations with Hans-Uwe Ditschlerin and then got caught up with dinner and everything. Then Mema called and immediately started telling me about her latest health issues. Did you like the new grid layout from Günter Zimmer?
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: elwira.plath@nordwind-energie.de
Sent: Monday, November 10, 2025 2:02 PM
To: Anke Anders
Subject: message from Langenberg


Langenberg is heading to Wittenmoor just before Christmas and wants to wrap up all the present prep beforehand... plus Langenberg has a packed event calendar once December starts... wish lists for you, Gottfried and P-nut would be very helpful!
</quoted>
